A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Rodian''' was a member of [[the Doomed]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. He was among the group of Doomed members who encountered [[Takara Hilts]] and [[Parlan Spinner]] when they landed on the continent of [[Eshkrene]].

==Biography==
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] was a member of [[the Doomed]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] order which consisted of the descendants of former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who had become stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] following the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. The Doomed resided in [[Eshkrene]], the planet's southern polar continent away from the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] which settled on Kesh's continent of [[Keshtah Minor]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. He lived in the [[City of the Doomed]], a settlement which was home to the Doomed community. The Doomed consisted of individuals from a wide range of [[Species/Legends|species]] including [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrians]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], Rodians, [[S'kytri]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]], and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. All members of the Doomed committed themselves to finding a balance between the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] sides of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. There were at least [[Unidentified Rodian Doomed member 2|two other Rodian members]] of the Doomed community.<ref name="Spiral 2" />
